name: claudestra
description: Orchestrate long-lived Claude Code sessions as a staff, with a chain of command: installs the claudestra CLI, keeps its guard in place, and ships its skills.

source.title: Install source
source.description: Where uv installs claudestra from; empty for this plugin's own release on GitHub. A git URL without a version, such as git+ssh://git@github.com/adityaruplaha/claudestra.git, is pinned to this plugin's version. A local checkout's path is for developing claudestra.
